propositions: Only P8 too-big blocks currently short-circuit plan review before LLM passes; P1/P5 deterministic blocking findings do not prevent LLM invocation, forcing full four-pass review on guaranteed-failing plans.
Widening the P8 short-circuit branch to catch any deterministic-floor blocking finding allows early termination with a BLOCK verdict, zero LLM finder calls, and coverage.llm_ran=False.
The short-circuit verdict must preserve all deterministic blocking findings and remediation text via the existing partition_findings/finalize_verdict path.
Plans passing the deterministic floor must proceed through full LLM passes unchanged after this change.
